forbiddenPatterns.label: paper-review task id
forbiddenPatterns.message: Formal skill must not contain a concrete paper-review task id.

forbiddenPatterns.label: paper id literal
forbiddenPatterns.message: Formal skill must not contain a concrete paper id.

forbiddenPatterns.label: gold/private answer source
forbiddenPatterns.pattern: \b(gold review|gold standard|gold rating|private answer|private oracle|ground[-_ ]?truth|official answer|hidden answer|reference answer|oracle answer)\b
forbiddenPatterns.message: Formal skill must not mention private/gold answer containers.

forbiddenPatterns.label: private answer path
forbiddenPatterns.message: Formal skill must not point to private answer files.

forbiddenPatterns.label: concrete Paper Rating heading
forbiddenPatterns.message: Formal skill may define the rating rubric, but must not include a concrete final Paper Rating value.

contextualForbidden.label: final rating leak
contextualForbidden.contextPattern: \b(this paper|current paper|gold|correct|expected|should be rated|must be rated|gold rating|assigned rating|target rating|rating is)\b
contextualForbidden.message: Concrete rating label appears in an answer-like context.

contextualForbidden.label: specific table reference
contextualForbidden.message: Concrete table/figure references in reusable skill are risky; keep only generic table-checking procedures.
